$comment: PF-70 flaky-test quarantine. Tests listed here still run on every PR in the quarantine (*) jobs, which show on the PR but are not inputs to ci-ok (the blocking gate); the PF-81 loader graphics entries run only from the manual workflow loader-gfx.yml (PF-75 a6, Owner 2026-11-20). Removing an entry and its ci.yml exclude puts the test back in the blocking jobs. Do not skip, delete, or weaken the test. Follow-up cards: PF-76 (M1-AC16), PF-77 (LH mobile TBT/perf), PF-78 (WebKit phone LCP), PF-79 (B-4 idle), PF-80 (Chromium visible-jump), PF-81 (loader graphics checks: no-GPU CI cannot judge luma/pixel/frame timing; restore them to the blocking jobs on a GPU runner), PF-82 (a11y 150 ms stepped-backdrop).
